claims.author: yuvicc
claims.harm: In pruned mode, requesting a pruned block returns 'I/O error reading block data' instead of 'Block not available'
claims.quote: In pruned mode when user calls `getrawtransaction <txid> <blockhash>` for the block that is pruned we return `"I/O error reading block data"` instead we should return `"Block not available"` which was

status_by.quote: My earlier concern has been addressed.

claims.status_note: yuvicc confirmed the earlier concern has been addressed

claims.author: musaHaruna
claims.quote: would it be safer to wrap the assertions in a `try...finally` block so that the block file is always restored, even if an assertion or unexpected exception causes the test to exit early.
claims.request: Wrap functional test assertions in a try...finally block so the renamed block file is always restored

status_by.quote: I don’t think a finally block is needed here: if an assertion fails, the functional test’s temporary datadir is deleted

claims.status_note: maflcko explained teardown deletes the temporary test directory anyway so restoring the file is unnecessary

claims.author: enirox001
claims.quote: Would a short release note make sense for this, since some rpcs now report index or read errors where they previously continued with other lookups or reported a missing tx?
claims.request: Add a short release note explaining that some RPCs now report index or read errors instead of continuing with fallback lookups or reporting a missing transaction

status_by.quote: Thanks for applying the changes. LGTM

claims.status_note: maflcko added the release note and enirox001 confirmed

claims.author: enirox001
claims.question: Whether throwing immediately in FindTx prevents callers from trying fallback lookups (such as UTXO set lookup in ProcessPSBT) that might succeed
claims.quote: I wonder if throwing immediately here could prevent callers from trying other lookups that might still succeed for example in `ProcessPSBT`

status_by.quote: Sounds good, letting the user know early on that the index is corrupted is a good idea

claims.status_note: maflcko clarified it is intentional to notify about index corruption early, and enirox001 agreed

claims.author: musaHaruna
claims.quote: Could we add this to the public methods of `CDBIterator` in `dbwrapper.h`?
claims.request: Add CDBIterator::CheckStatus and call it in FindTx so LevelDB iterator errors throw instead of returning nullopt

status_by.quote: Yes I think a separate PR makes sense. I will open one as a follow-up to this.

claims.status_note: maflcko noted this is a pre-existing issue that makes sense as a follow-up PR, and musaHaruna agreed to open one

claims.author: furszy
claims.quote: Mentioning "OpenBlockFile" in the error message doesn't seem the best for the user, it shares internals. May be better to change it to something like "Failed to open file for block hash %s".
claims.request: Avoid mentioning internal function names like OpenBlockFile in the error message

status_by.quote: np for me. Happy to move forward in any direction.

claims.status_note: furszy agreed to move forward in any direction rather than updating this PR

claims.author: ryanofsky
claims.question: Whether to include the change skipping leftover txindex entries after an unclean shutdown in this PR or leave it for a follow-up
claims.quote: would you want to include the change suggested in the comment about leftover txindex entries after an unclean shutdown?

claims.author: ryanofsky
claims.quote: The new test renames `blk00000.dat` before waiting for the txindex to finish syncing, and if the sync reads a block while the file is missing, the node shuts down. Calling `sync_txindex(self, node)` before the rename avoids this.
claims.request: Call sync_txindex before renaming blk00000.dat in rpc_rawtransaction.py to avoid intermittent test failures

claims.author: ryanofsky
claims.quote: Catching the `FindTx` error when a block hash is given and falling through to the block read would avoid this.
claims.request: Catch FindTx errors and fall through to block read when a block hash is given in getrawtransaction

claims.author: ryanofsky
claims.quote: the release note's 'internal error' could be read as `RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR` (-32603), while these errors return `RPC_MISC_ERROR` (-1).
claims.request: Clarify release note wording so internal error is not confused with RPC_INTERNAL_ERROR (-32603)

claims.author: ryanofsky
claims.quote: the race this comment describes could be closed by checking again after the read fails
claims.request: Close the pruning race in getrawtransaction by re-checking block data availability if GetTransaction throws

claims.author: ryanofsky
claims.quote: skip index entries left behind by an unclean shutdown instead of throwing here and in the `BLOCK_HAVE_DATA` check below
claims.request: Skip txindex entries left behind by an unclean shutdown instead of throwing, so lookups do not permanently fail until the index is rebuilt
